root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the final end-of-line cleanup compares `args[arg]` against `out + arg_start`, `parse_line()` must establish `arg < argsmax` so the cleanup never reuses an argument index that was not recorded as a valid start slot.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing path, the final cleanup reaches `final_cleanup_guard` with `arg == 65` and `argsmax == 64`, yet the protected `args[arg]` read still executes. The fixed original reaches the same guard with the original witness but suppresses the read, and the adjacent `boundary_64_tokens` witness executes the protected event genuinely with `arg == 63 < 64`.

nodes.state: At the final empty-argument comparison, the vulnerable execution forms `&args[arg]` exactly at `args + argsmax + 1` and then dereferences `args[arg]`, matching the AddressSanitizer-reported one-slot-past-end stack read.
The last separator-close in the main parsing loop increments `arg` to the final token index that later reaches the end-of-line cleanup unchanged.

edges.relation: The same `arg` value observed at the missing final guard is the index immediately used by the protected `args[arg]` read.

edges.via: arg after separator close -> arg at final cleanup
edges.relation: The last separator-close `arg++` produces the same index later checked by the final end-of-line cleanup.
